overloadPatches.semanticRole: Removes all columns of every table intersecting targetObj (a range, element, or 4D Write Pro document); does nothing if targetObj does not intersect a table.
Removes numColumns column(s) from tableRef starting at colNumber (default numColumns = 1 if omitted).

constraints: With the targetObj syntax, the numColumns parameter (if it were passed) is ignored; only the targetObj syntax's own tables/columns matter.
Removing all columns of a table removes the entire table.
